name: Saved by the Werewolf
source: Your family members don’t trust you. You don’t believe in harming humans, and when they kick you out, you are saved by a handsome man. He’s an Alpha wolf. You have to make a choice. Stay, or leave.
translation: 家人不信任你。你不认同伤害人类的做法，被他们赶出家门后，一位英俊的男人救了你。他是一名阿尔法狼人。你必须做出选择，留下，或是离开。
